description: This file defines the HomeViewModel class for an Android application. It provides state management for the home screen, including placeholder data for different categories (rails) used in UI testing and development. It uses Kotlin coroutines' StateFlow to expose reactive UI states.

classes.name: HomeViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class providing placeholder state data for the home screen, including nested data classes RailItem and RailState for representing individual items and category states respectively.

classes.name: RailItem
classes.description: A data class representing a single media item with a name and optional poster URL.

classes.name: RailState
classes.description: A data class representing the loading state, error message, and list of items for a media category.

methods.name: loadAll
methods.description: Populates the state with predefined placeholder data across multiple categories for UI testing and compilation.
